title: Weather flashcards
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Special days, summer and numbers
source: Written for arabic/y3 lesson 6 (Weather flashcards (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 6: Summer: the weather and what we do. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: What I do in summer
points: أَسْبَحُ (asbahu) I swim; أَلْعَبُ (al'abu) I play
أَشْرَبُ مَاءً (ashrabu ma'an) I drink water

blocks.task: say the Arabic, turn over and check, or play pairs with a partner.

questions.q: Core: Draw a sun and a pool (no people) and label them شَمْسٌ and الصَّيْفُ. Write الجَوُّ حَارٌّ underneath.
Extend: Write two things you do in summer, starting فِي الصَّيْفِ.
questions.a: For example: فِي الصَّيْفِ أَسْبَحُ. فِي الصَّيْفِ أَشْرَبُ مَاءً.

questions.q: Stretch: Write one sentence about winter: الجَوُّ بَارِدٌ فِي الشِّتَاءِ.
questions.a: The weather is cold in winter.
B) The weather is hot. حَارٌّ (harr) is hot; بَارِدٌ (barid) is cold.

questions.q: What is 'summer' in Arabic? A) الشِّتَاءُ B) الصَّيْفُ C) شَمْسٌ
Big question: describe summer weather in Arabic.
questions.a: الجَوُّ حَارٌّ (the weather is hot); there is شَمْسٌ (sun).
